item.group_name: Composed pieces (several tools, one finished thing)
item.title: Choose My Thumbnail Headline

turns.text: Make a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for my video about quitting late-night scrolling and sleeping better. Invent a tired-looking person for it and choose a punchy three-word headline yourself. Big face, easy to read on a phone.

item.tests: Tests choosing suitable unspecified headline wording and delivering a complete face-and-text thumbnail without unnecessary clarification.

answer_sheet.Video topic: Quitting late-night scrolling to sleep better.
answer_sheet.Person: Invent a tired-looking person; age, appearance and placement are your call.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: One 16:9 YouTube thumbnail; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: One finished 16:9 thumbnail with a large, visibly tired-looking human face.
A completed headline of exactly three words appears in the image, not placeholder text.
The headline clearly relates to stopping late-night scrolling or improving sleep.
The headline is high-contrast and readable at phone-thumbnail size.
The face and headline remain unobstructed, with neither cropped awkwardly at the image edges.

approvals.name: generate_image

args.name: Stop Scrolling Sleep Better — Video Thumbnail

style.prompt: Create a highly clickable professional YouTube thumbnail about quitting late-night phone scrolling and sleeping better. 16:9 landscape composition, readable at tiny size. Dramatic split-screen before and after: left side tired adult awake in bed staring at smartphone, cold electric blue screen light on face, dark midnight bedroom, subtle red warning accent; right side same adult peacefully asleep with phone set aside face down, cozy warm amber bedroom and soft bedding. Strong emotional contrast, cinematic photorealistic editorial imagery, crisp clear faces, uncluttered background, saturated complementary blue and amber palette. Large bold ultra-legible white and yellow headline across upper middle in two lines, exact wording: 'STOP SCROLLING' and 'SLEEP BETTER'. Thick dark outline on lettering, generous safe margins, text must not obscure faces. A small simple curved arrow leads from phone toward peaceful sleep. No extra text, no logos, no watermarks.
